entries.name: Emergency Authority
entries.description: Generic emergency-action authority empowered to declare exceptional policy under a pre-existing emergency mandate. The specific authority instance and action are identified in extensions.declared_policy.

entries.name: Chain Authority
entries.description: Actor with direct technical authority to implement protocol-level changes outside the standard governance vote path (e.g., core developer team, protocol foundation). Distinct from EMG (emergency mandate holder) and PCY (governance quorum). The specific authority instance is identified in extensions.declared_policy.authority_identity.

entries.name: Oracle
entries.description: Oracle network or attestation service that observes external state and signs structured claims. Default trust basis is an M-of-N bonded attestor set (bonded_quorum, ceiling B); a native-notarized oracle variant is documented under native_notarized_consensus.
